clause_text: the landlord may increase rent by 20% at any time without notice
tenant shall be responsible for all structural repairs irrespective of cause
landlord may terminate the agreement without prior notice
security deposit may be deducted at landlord's sole discretion without receipts
notice period for tenant is 90 days but landlord can terminate with 15 days
the landlord may disconnect utilities if payment is delayed
all disputes shall be decided solely by the landlord
the landlord may verbally modify any provision
the landlord shall provide possession of the property on 1 December 2026
monthly rent shall be Rs. 25000 per month
monthly rent of rupees 32000 payable on or before 5th of every month
security deposit of Rs. 150000 refundable at the end of tenancy
lock-in period of 12 months from commencement date
tenant shall give 90 days written notice before vacating
subletting or assigning the premises is not permitted without prior written consent
tenant shall pay electricity water and other utility bills
stamp duty and registration charges shall be borne equally by both parties
landlord may enter premises after giving 24 hours prior notice
agreement is governed by the laws of India and courts of Bengaluru shall have jurisdiction
tenant shall bear costs of minor repairs up to Rs. 500
penalty of Rs. 5000 per day for every day of delay in payment
landlord may enter the premises at any time without informing the tenant
tenant responsible for all repairs including structural damage irrespective of cause
landlord may deduct any amount from security deposit without providing receipts
landlord may terminate tenancy at any time without notice or reason
all disputes to be decided solely and exclusively by the landlord
landlord reserves right to increase rent by any amount at any time without consent
